definitions: To bring or come together again in order to revive or recover.
To recover or cause to recover in health, spirits, or strength.
To make a comeback or recover in a game or contest.
To assemble for a common purpose, typically a protest or demonstration.
examples: The team managed to rally in the second half.
She rallied her supporters for the cause.
His health began to rally after the treatment.
Thousands rallied in the city square.
